comparison.objective: Snap a lid all around a full paper cup, versus snap a collet into an eccentric nut ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive circumferential rim pressing while stabilizing a crushable, spillable cup; candidate uses marked groove entry followed by tilt-roll engagement of a rigid small part.
comparison.success_condition: Entire lid rim must be sealed without spill, tip or cup deformation; candidate requires 3-second retention and withdrawal resistance. Candidate lacks numeric snap-force and pull thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both use snap engagement, but rim closure around a deformable vessel does not test eccentric groove capture or collet insertion.
